caption: The video showcases a close-up, shallow-focus view of a heaped pile of glossy roasted coffee beans. The beans fill the lower two-thirds of the frame against a warm, out-of-focus amber background. Faint wisps of pale steam hover just above the bean surface, drifting and re-forming slowly. Throughout the excerpt the entire scene translates steadily toward the left, so a bright orange-toned bean at the lower edge slides out of view while previously unseen beans enter along the right margin. The relative arrangement of the beans to one another remains fixed, indicating a lateral camera movement across the pile rather than the beans themselves shifting. The blurred background and soft warm color balance stay essentially constant as the pan continues.
relations: Faint pale steam hovers above the bean surface, drifting and re-forming slowly as the scene pans.
A bright orange-toned bean at the lower edge slides out of view as the scene translates steadily left.
Unseen beans enter along the right margin while the relative arrangement of the bean pile remains fixed.
The blurred warm amber background and soft color balance stay essentially constant throughout the lateral camera movement.
